bases.name: Archon Plate
bases.notes: Non-ETH 3s Enigma; 4s Fortitude (ETH 4s = merc). Lowest-STR elite armor for Enigma. Superior 15% ED is premium.
bases.keep_summary: Superior 10-15% ED with correct socket count.

bases.name: Mage Plate
bases.notes: Lowest STR req (55) for Enigma.

bases.name: Dusk Shroud
bases.notes: Light elite armor. Non-ETH 3s Enigma; ETH 4s Fortitude merc.

bases.name: Wyrmhide
bases.notes: Low STR (84) Enigma alt.

bases.name: Scarab Husk
bases.notes: Enigma alt, higher STR req.

bases.name: Sacred Armor
bases.notes: Highest base defense. ETH 4s Fortitude merc. Keep all ETH Superior Sacred Armors.

bases.name: Shadow Plate
bases.notes: Near-Sacred defense, Fortitude merc alt.

bases.name: Loricated Mail
bases.notes: High defense Fortitude merc alt.

bases.name: Demonhead (Shrunken Head)
bases.notes: Elite necro shrunken head. ETH 3s Coven (RotW 3s helm) or Dream. Superior ETH 3s is premium.

bases.name: Bone Visage
bases.notes: Elite necro helm. ETH 3s Dream merc.

bases.name: Corona
bases.notes: Flickering Flame / Dream base; highest-defense circlet-tier helm.

bases.name: Tiara
bases.notes: Low-STR circlet base; best gambling target for +skills/FCR.

bases.name: Diadem
bases.notes: Highest-tier circlet; best gambling base for +2 class / +3 tree.

bases.name: Great Helm
bases.notes: Lore / budget merc option.

bases.name: Armet
bases.notes: Elite helm; Lore (2s) or budget merc helm.

bases.name: Monarch
bases.notes: Spirit / Exile / Phoenix base. Lowest STR (156) of the 4-socket elite shields. Larzuk gives 4 (needs ilvl 41+). Keep all non-ETH Monarchs.

bases.name: Aegis
bases.notes: 4-socket elite shield (219 STR). Spirit / Exile / Phoenix alternate to Monarch.

bases.name: Ward
bases.notes: Highest-defense non-Paladin 4-socket shield (185 STR). Exile / Phoenix.

bases.name: Sacred Targe
bases.notes: 75% base block. Preferred for Spirit / Exile / Dream.

bases.name: Vortex Shield
bases.notes: 75% base block; co-equal to Sacred Targe.

bases.name: Zakarum Shield
bases.notes: 60% base block; Exile / Conviction builds.

bases.name: Kurast Shield
bases.notes: 45% base block; budget - keep if 4 sockets.

bases.name: Grimoire (any, 2 socket)
bases.notes: Vigilance (Dol + Gul, RotW 2-socket Shield/Head/Book runeword) - core Warlock off-hand. Keep all 2-socket grimoires.

bases.name: Elite Grimoire (Occult Tome / Codex / Blasphemous)
bases.notes: Elite-tier RotW books (highest Warlock staffmods). Keep clean 2-3 socket bases for Vigilance or unique re-rolls.

bases.name: Crystal Sword
bases.notes: Spirit / Call to Arms (4s), lowest-req 4os sword. Needs exactly 4 - farm a 4os (Nightmare cows) since Larzuk gives 6 at high ilvl.

bases.name: Phase Blade
bases.notes: Grief (5s). Indestructible / cannot be ethereal. 4s = Spirit/CtA, 6s = Last Wish. (Mosaic is claws-only - not Phase Blade.)

bases.name: Colossus Blade
bases.notes: High-damage 2H. ETH 5s Death (natural 5os) or 6s Breath of the Dying (Larzuk gives 6).

bases.name: Colossus Sword
bases.notes: ETH 5s Death - Larzuk gives 5, so easy to socket.

bases.name: Berserker Axe
bases.notes: Top melee axe base. ETH 5s Grief or Death (natural 5os); 6s Breath of the Dying.

bases.name: Glorious Axe
bases.notes: ETH 5s Death - Larzuk gives 5. Fury Druid / Barb favorite.

bases.name: Colossus Axe
bases.notes: ETH 5s Death (natural 5os) or 6s Breath of the Dying.

bases.name: Thunder Maul
bases.notes: ETH 4s Fortitude weapon; 6s Breath of the Dying (Larzuk gives 6). ETH safe for Echoing Strike in 3.2.

bases.name: Ghost Spear
bases.notes: Elite spear. ETH 4s Infinity merc (needs a natural 4os - Larzuk gives 6); 6s Breath of the Dying.

bases.name: War Pike
bases.notes: Highest-damage elite spear. ETH 4s Infinity (natural 4os - Larzuk gives 6) or 6s Breath of the Dying.

bases.name: Stygian Pike
bases.notes: ETH 4s Infinity merc spear - Larzuk gives 4, so good value and easy to socket.

bases.name: Mancatcher
bases.notes: Fast elite spear. ETH 4s Infinity needs a natural 4os (Larzuk gives 5).

bases.name: Hyperion Spear
bases.notes: Max 3 sockets - cannot make Infinity/Insight/Pride (need 4) or BotD (need 6). Generally skip.

bases.name: Thresher
bases.notes: BiS Infinity / Insight / Pride merc polearm - fastest, Larzuk gives 4. ETH mandatory for merc.

bases.name: Giant Thresher
bases.notes: Infinity merc alt - highest-damage fast polearm. Larzuk gives 4.

bases.name: Cryptic Axe
bases.notes: ETH 4s Insight/Infinity (natural 4os - Larzuk gives 5) or 5s Obedience. Low STR req.

bases.name: Great Poleaxe
bases.notes: High-damage polearm. ETH 4s Infinity needs a natural 4os (Larzuk gives 6); 6s Breath of the Dying.

bases.name: Colossus Voulge
bases.notes: ETH 4s Insight / Infinity - Larzuk gives 4 (easiest Infinity base). Slow, high STR.

bases.name: Archon Staff
bases.notes: 6s Obsession (premium caster/Warlock 2H). Larzuk gives 6. +3 staffmod base can reach +7 to a skill.

bases.name: Rune Staff
bases.notes: Exceptional staff in the same line - also 6s Obsession base.

bases.name: Fanged Knife
bases.notes: Only elite dagger that reaches 3 sockets (Larzuk gives 3). Void / Ritual (RotW 3s dagger runewords). Keep non-ETH; +Warlock skill mods add value. (Legend Spike maxes at 2 - cannot do these.)

bases.name: Greater Talons
bases.notes: Fast claw, 3s Mosaic / Chaos. NOTE: Mosaic is DISABLED on the S14 ladder (non-ladder only). Value comes from +3 Phoenix Strike / Claws of Thunder / Dragon Talon.

bases.name: Runic Talons / Scissors Suwayyah
bases.notes: Elite 3s Mosaic / Chaos claw. Mosaic disabled on S14 ladder; non-ladder only.

bases.name: Druid Pelt
bases.notes: Dream (3s) or high +skills. (Spirit is sword/shield only - not pelts.)

bases.name: Necromancer Shrunken Head
bases.notes: Rhyme / Splendor / Vigilance (2s). Max 3 sockets - Spirit needs 4, so not possible here.

bases.name: Necromancer Wand
bases.notes: White wand with +3 to a skill (Bone Spear / Bone Armor) for White runeword (Dol Io).

bases.name: Grand Matron / Matriarchal / Shadow Bow
bases.notes: Faith (4s). Needs a natural 4os since Larzuk gives 5. BiS Grand Matron Bow; Matriarchal/Shadow Bow are fast alts. ETH for a merc bow.

catch_all_rules.label: ETH elite weapon - quick check
catch_all_rules.notes: Quick fallback: an ETH elite weapon can be valuable, but the useful socket count depends on the base and runeword (4 = Infinity/Insight/Pride, 5 = Death/Grief/Obedience, 6 = Breath of the Dying). Check the specific base for its max sockets.
